schema.content:
Table "Award" {
  "award_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "organization" TEXT
  "year" INTEGER
  "award_category" TEXT
  "award" TEXT
  "series" TEXT
  "episode_id" TEXT
  "person_id" TEXT
  "role" TEXT
  "result" TEXT
}

Table "Credit" {
  "episode_id" TEXT [pk]
  "person_id" TEXT [pk]
  "category" TEXT
  "role" TEXT
  "credited" TEXT
}

Table "Episode" {
  "episode_id" TEXT [pk]
  "series" TEXT
  "season" INTEGER
  "episode" INTEGER
  "number_in_series" INTEGER
  "title" TEXT
  "summary" TEXT
  "air_date" DATE
  "episode_image" TEXT
  "rating" REAL
  "votes" INTEGER
}

Table "Keyword" {
  "episode_id" TEXT [pk]
  "keyword" TEXT [pk]
}

Table "Person" {
  "person_id" TEXT [pk]
  "name" TEXT
  "birthdate" DATE
  "birth_name" TEXT
  "birth_place" TEXT
  "birth_region" TEXT
  "birth_country" TEXT
  "height_meters" REAL
  "nickname" TEXT
}

Table "Vote" {
  "episode_id" TEXT
  "stars" INTEGER
  "votes" INTEGER
  "percent" REAL
}



Ref: "Keyword"."episode_id" > "Episode"."episode_id"

Ref: "Award"."person_id" > "Person"."person_id"

Ref: "Award"."episode_id" > "Episode"."episode_id"

Ref: "Credit"."person_id" > "Person"."person_id"

Ref: "Credit"."episode_id" > "Episode"."episode_id"

Ref: "Vote"."episode_id" > "Episode"."episode_id"
